note: 749.207, a trial: the kept share of a part's lines (from its second, four notes or more) that repeat the line before or the line two before, within one section. 'other' is every part that is neither a verse nor a chorus; a part with no table of its own takes 'all'.
by_count_note: 749.209, a trial: of a part's nearby line pairs (a line and the line before or two before, both four notes or more) whose syllable counts differ by 0, 1, 2, 3 or more, the share that are repeats; by_count by the best of three alignments, by_count_strict aligned from the first note.
